DATA-QUALITY NOTE (measured 2026-09-09, review of Sultan's OCR pipeline): this row does NOT cover the whole book. The OCR ran pages 27-321 and extracted 1,278 entries, of which 473 (37%) are shipped: 253 high_confidence plus 220 easy_review_auto_approved; the other 805 (63%) were excluded as hard_review or rejected. 228 of 295 pages are represented (77%), and the 67 pages contributing nothing are scattered rather than whole sections (one run of 6 pages, 314-319). Tesseract headword confidence has a median of 67.7 with 70% below 80 and 63 entries (13.3%) below 40, all auto-approved without human review; those 63 are queued in docs/najdi_low_confidence_review.csv. 57 of 473 glosses (12.1%) still contain OCR page-number residue. The Arabic-character-ratio and garbled-token heuristics pass cleanly (median 96.4%, zero garbled tokens, comparable to the CC BY-SA EPUB's 95.6%) but are near-blind to this source's real failure mode, which is plausible-but-wrong words rather than concatenated junk. Treat this as a confidently-OCR'd subset of the dictionary, not the dictionary.
